observations.claim: Both generated candidates attempted a continuation heuristic but were rejected before scoring: candidate 1 used forbidden np.empty and candidate 2 used forbidden np.linspace. There is no distance evidence against lookahead itself.

next_search_advice.direction: Make the one-step continuation hypothesis evaluable.

memory_action.name: lookahead-capability-contract
memory_action.description: Use allowed primitives for CVRP lookahead
memory_action.body:
**Why:** The two lookahead proposals in round 5 were rejected on np.empty and np.linspace before route scoring.

**How to apply:** Use a small shortlist, ordinary loops or list append, boolean indexing and np.min instead of allocating scratch arrays with np.empty or computing weights with np.linspace.

**Limitations:** Frozen six-instance CVRP development suite and current evaluator only.
